name: Home Assistant – LLM Vision
summary: Home Assistant LLM Vision integration: analyze camera images with AI, query the vision timeline, and create timeline events.

tools.name: llmvision_get_image
tools.description: Download a keyframe image from HA LLM Vision media storage. Pass a key_frame path from a timeline event (e.g. /media/llmvision/snapshots/xxx.jpg). Returns the local file path for use with the image or message tools.

key_frame.description: The key_frame path from a timeline event (e.g. /media/llmvision/snapshots/abc123-camera0.jpg).

tools.name: llmvision_timeline_get
tools.description: Get events from the LLM Vision timeline (calendar.llm_vision_timeline). Returns a list of AI-generated observation events with timestamps, summaries, and descriptions. Useful for reviewing what the cameras have seen recently.

start_time.description: Start of the query window as ISO 8601 (e.g. '2026-04-09T00:00:00+00:00'). Defaults to now minus days.

end_time.description: End of the query window as ISO 8601. Defaults to now.

days.description: Number of days to look back when start_time is not set (default: 7).

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (default: 50, max: 200).

tools.name: llmvision_analyze_image
tools.description: Trigger an AI image analysis on a Home Assistant camera entity using LLM Vision. Sends the current camera snapshot to the specified AI provider with a custom prompt and returns the AI-generated description. Can optionally store the result in the timeline.

camera_entity.description: Camera entity ID to analyze (e.g. camera.front_door).

message.description: Prompt / question to send to the AI about the image.

model.description: Specific model override (optional, uses provider default if omitted).

store_in_timeline.description: Whether to save the result as a timeline event (default: false).

expose_images.description: Whether to expose the captured image in the timeline event.

generate_title.description: Whether to auto-generate a title for the timeline event.

response_format.description: Response format from the AI: 'text' (default) or 'json'.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens for the AI response.

tools.name: llmvision_create_event
tools.description: Create a new event in the LLM Vision timeline. Use this to manually log observations or detections with optional camera image, label category, and time range.
